== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Lemon is a pale, bald human woman characterized by a bright yellow tattoo of a lemon cross-section on her skull. She is associated with [[the Advocates]], wearing a specialized suit featuring yellow accents and an 'L' insignia. A powerful individual with magical abilities, she possesses the capacity to release an acidic substance resembling lemon juice that can erode shields and create hazardous minefields in space. Despite being vastly outnumbered during conflicts, she remains defiant and determined to rebuild [[the Advocates]]. Lemon is in a relationship with [[Omega]], an entity with extra limbs, and she is described as a constant source of surprises who maintains her composure even after experiencing the effects of madness.}}
